title: Escalation Budget Scheduler and SLA Burn Forecast for High-Value Accounts
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and Customer Success frequently request delivery guarantees or roadmap accelerations for top customers. We lack a standardized way to budget those escalations (feature time/priority slots) and predict SLA burn across roadmap commits, which causes over-commitment and churn risk.

Goal: Design and deliver an Escalation Budget Scheduler and SLA Burn Forecasting pipeline that 1) lets account owners request and reserve limited escalation budget, 2) forecasts the impact of accepted escalations on roadmap SLOs and engineering capacity, and 3) surfaces a live burn rate and risk score in the Redwood Console for PMs and account teams.

Scope:
- Intake: new structured VIP intake form (CS + Sales fields) and priority cohort tags.
- Scheduler: allocation engine that reserves discrete 'escalation budget units' (time or sprint points) per quarter per top-account cohort.
- Forecast: SLA burn model using committed work, historical velocity, and runtime/infra risk (capacity for Dedicated/Private).
- Console UX: new dashboard widget (per-account and global) showing reserved budget, used budget, forecasted burn, and time-to-breach alerts.
- Playbooks: guardrails for acceptance, rollback, and customer communication.

Deliverables: PRD (linked), intake form doc, prioritization algorithm spec, prototype dashboard, rollout plan to CS/Sales, and post-launch evaluation plan (retention + NPS delta).

Non-goals: automatic re-prioritization of other customers' tickets; enforcement of contracts (legal to handle billing/credits).
acceptance_criteria: Structured VIP intake form live in Confluence and linked from CS workspace
Escalation budget allocation algorithm implemented and validated on synthetic data (simulation results attached)
Console dashboard shows per-account reserved vs. consumed budget and forecasted breach date with <5% error on simulation
Alerting: account owner receives automated warning when forecasted breach within 14 days
SLA burn forecasts are included in weekly roadmap health report and can be filtered by region, tier, and product line
